'''March 2000 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, TX on 25 March 2000. [[Matt Lush]] won it. It is known from Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d389">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revod389/ austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revo], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 26 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-26-austin-tx-3-25-000-test-of-the-revod389/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Lush]]
